content: Leaflet 1.9.4 / react-leaflet 5.0.0, MIT licensed, mature ecosystem. Self-hosting requires either pre-rendered raster PNG tiles (low-zoom-only world coverage is a few MB) or Leaflet.VectorGrid + a self-hosted pbf vector source -- more manual setup and a less actively maintained vector-tile plugin path than MapLibre GL's native vector pipeline. Viable but not the best offline story of the three options.
